provenance.instrument: Code of the Township of Middletown (Bucks County), Chapter 500 Zoning, as published on eCode360
provenance.status_detail: eCode360 (code MI2390): includes legislation through 12-16-2024. New Laws lists five Chapter 500 amendments not yet codified: Ord. 25-01 (townhouses in P), 25-02 (CDT overlay), 25-03 (AQC district), 26-05 (logistics center overlay) and 26-06 (chickens). All five were read. None mentions accessory dwellings. The township zoning page links to this chapter, which confirms it is the Bucks County Middletown.
provenance.code_current_through_note: eCode360: Includes legislation through 12-16-2024. Five later Chapter 500 ordinances (2025-02-18 to 2026-08-10) are listed under New Laws.
checks: The zoning code has no accessory dwelling unit, accessory apartment or in-law provision
R-1, R-2 and R-3 allow listed principal and accessory uses 'and no other'. Single-family detached is the only dwelling type listed (500-802, 500-902, 500-1002)
A residential conversion of an existing building into two or more units is a special exception in RA-1, RA-2, RA-3, R-1, R-2, R-3, MR and P (500-2312)
A conversion needs the single-family minimum lot area for each unit. Two units: R-1 30,000, R-2 20,000, R-3 14,000 sq ft (500-2312B)
Conversion parking: 2 spaces per unit with three bedrooms or fewer, at the side or rear of the building (500-2312J)
A converted house keeps one front entrance and its exterior look. Each unit needs 200 sq ft of patio or recreation area. Minimum unit sizes apply, for example 500 sq ft for one bedroom
Accessory rules, not ADU rules: garages and sheds at most 3% of lot area and 500 sq ft, 14 ft high. Garages 5 ft and sheds 3 ft from lot lines, 10 ft behind the rear of the house (500-2402)
provenance.notes: Zoning office: Department of Building and Zoning, https://middletownbucks.org/Departments/Building-Zoning/Zoning-Information. Searched Chapter 500 and the five uncodified amendments for: accessory dwelling, accessory apartment, in-law, granny, elder cottage, ECHO, carriage house, second dwelling, accessory residential, guest house, accessory living, kitchen. No ADU provision. Index note: MI2390 is the right code. The Ch. 275 and MI1283 lead was another Middletown.

value.name: Residential conversion of an existing house into two units
value.conditions: Existing building only, no major exterior change, single front entrance. Each unit needs the single-family minimum lot area. Units at least 400 (efficiency), 500 (1 BR), 650 (2 BR) sq ft. 200 sq ft patio per unit. 2 spaces per unit (3 or fewer bedrooms) at the side or rear.

Units at least 400 (efficiency), 500 (1 BR), 650 (2 BR) sq ft. 200 sq ft patio per unit. 2 spaces per unit (3 or fewer bedrooms) at the side or rear. District minimum lot area per unit applies.

alternatives.note: Two-unit lot figures are twice the district single-family minimum (500-803A, 500-903A, 500-1003A).

path.note: Reading: R-2 allows uses 'and no other'. A second unit is not listed. A use variance is the path. A unit inside an existing house may fit a residential conversion by special exception if the lot is large enough (500-2312).

zoning_districts.note: No district lists an ADU. Reading of a silent code.

historic_bypass.note: No ADU text, so no historic path.

types_allowed.note: No ADU form is listed. Conversion of an existing building is a separate two-unit use.

max_height_ft.note: Accessory rule for garages and sheds, not an ADU rule. The code allows no ADU. Residential accessory structures: 'a maximum building height of 14 feet'.

setback_front_ft.note: Garages and sheds must be 10 ft farther back from the street line than the rear of the house.

setback_side_ft.note: Accessory rule: garages 'not less than five feet from any property line'. Sheds 3 ft.

setback_rear_ft.note: Accessory rule: garages 5 ft, sheds 3 ft.

separation_ft.note: No separation between buildings found in 500-2402.

accessory_structure_max_sqft.note: Accessory rule for garages and sheds, not an ADU rule. 'limited to 3% of the lot area up to a maximum of 500 square feet'

family_only.note: No ADU rule. A family may include 'domestic servants or gratuitous guests'.

max_adus.note: Reading: 0 means the code allows no ADU. A second unit needs a use variance or a residential conversion (500-2312).
